name: Project Explorer Menus
summary: Right-click menus for the open file and Project Explorer rows: open in new tab, reveal, copy path, show path (SDK sample · docs/97)
description:
A starter extension for growing the right-click menu of the open file.
Step 1 (this version): a 'Project Explorer Menus' submenu in the editor context menu with one command, Show file path, which asks the host for the active document's path (nx_host_get / Editor::doc_path) and writes it to the app log (developer mode, ext layer).
Step 2 (0.2.0): the submenu also appears when right-clicking a file row in the Project Explorer (commands act on that row's path), plus file actions Open in new tab / Reveal in Project Explorer / Copy file path, a setting ext.project_explorer_menus.log_path (Preferences ▸ Extensions ▸ Project Explorer Menus) and a default shortcut Ctrl+Alt+Shift+P for Show file path.
author: SosomLab

messages.install: Project Explorer Menus is on — right-click in an editor or on a Project Explorer file row: Project Explorer Menus > Open / Reveal / Copy path / Show file path.
